Add tests proving the default path reaches answer with zero prior model calls, agent mode restores triage, and explicit routes, labels, and implicit follow-ups are unaffected. Update request-lifecycle, overall-design, configuration, supported-workflow, and relevant README documentation. Treat closed unmerged PRs #447 and #449 as context only.
